reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia! Now, when you shape the ground, the water responds dynamically without freezing the frame. Check out the full details on our development blog: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics Update!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to the water mechanics in Provincia. Water now interacts with terrain in real-time, eliminating previous freezing issues when shaping the ground. For a deeper dive into the changes, visit our development blog: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
